WFF_ADR_ADD_2.desc: When set to 0, disable feedback v-sync reset FIFO. WRITE FIFO Address count select: When it’s set to 1, address added by 2 per pixel. When it’s set to 0, address added by 1 per pixel

WFF_ENABLE.desc: Enable write FIFO When it’s set 1, write FIFO will be turn on

WFF_FF_HALF_REQ.desc: When it’s set 0, write FIFO will be turn off. Request generated when FIFO half When set to 1, request generated when FIFO half. When set to 0, request generate when FIFO write pointer is 1

WFF_FF_STATUS.desc: Write FIFO status When wff_cntrl_[15] set 1’b1, this register will be valid, this value will less than 64

WFF_FF_STATUS_SEL.desc: blank rising edge, set 0 write FIFO request will free run WRITE FIFO HALF STATUS SELECT When set to 1, request generated when FIFO is half. When set to 0, request generated when c FIFO is delm’s value

WFF_FF_STA_INV.desc: Write FIFO status invert When set to 1, write FIFO status invert

WFF_LAST_POP_CTL.desc: When set to 1, horizontal or vertical load start address will check if there is pop When set to 0, horizontal or vertical load start address will not check

WFF_LINE_FLIP.desc: When set 1, line id will be inverted;

WFF_REQ_OVER.desc: WRITE FIFO Horizontal Request End When this bit set 1, the final write FIFO request of one line is in the horizontal

WFF_SAFE_GUARD.desc: When set to 0, write FIFO status don’t change. Enable write FIFO safe guard When set to 1, enable write FIFO safe guard. When set to 0, disable write FIFO safe guard

WFF_SAFE_GUARD_A.desc: Write FIFO Buffer A Safe Guard Address [20:16] Safe guard address buffer A [20:16], Mapping to 32bits width data bus field

WFF_SAFE_GUARD_B.desc: Write FIFO Buffer B Safe Guard Address [20:16] Safe guard address buffer B [20:16], Mapping to 32bits width data bus field

WFF_TST_REG.desc: WRITE FIFO Test logic control: BIT[7:0] : SELECT CAPTURE INTERNAL TEST BUS

WFF_VRST_FF_RST.desc: Enable input V-sync reset FIFO When set to 1, enable feedback v-sync reset FIFO

WFF_YUV_DEINTERLACE.desc: WRITE FIFO YUV DE-INTERLACE When set 1, write FIFO will write one field YUV, set 0, will write one frame Y
